Get the daily averages of one sensor

Source: R/fct_data.R
get_daily.Rd

The average of the hourly averages of each whole day, midnight to midnight in the time zone of the app, of the days days before today, for the Air Quality tab. Today, still running, is left out, and so is a day with readings in fewer than 18 of its hours (75%), as in the usual rules for daily averages of air quality.

Usage

get_daily(urlq, metric, days = 30, end_time = Sys.time())

Arguments

urlq

Prometheus query_range url.

metric

Name of the metric, one of metrics.

days

Number of days, up to the start of the current hour.

end_time

A time on the day after the last day, by default now.

Value

A data frame with one row per day: date (a Date), value (the average) and hours (how many hours had readings). It has no rows when no day has enough readings, and is NULL, with a message, when the server cannot be reached.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
url <- "http://pip1.crabdance.com:1507/api/v1/query_range"
get_daily(url, "PM25", days = 30)
} # }
